reason: I already know I scroll too long, but my phone sleeps next to me and I look at it first thing. I doubt a nice wooden clock would change that, and I would just bring the phone to bed anyway.
objection: I need my phone near me anyway, for emergencies. Favourites letting calls through is something, but I would not trust it enough to leave the phone in another room, and if it stays beside me this is a 120 euro alarm clock.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work in a friend's home for a couple of weeks, plus proof that a call from my family really rings through to the other room every time.
